Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02136] Reporting "DoIP routing request rejected" to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a "DoIP routing activation request" does not lead to a "routing activation
response code" that activates routing, the DM shall report a security event
SEV_DOIP_ROUTING_ACTIVATION_CHECK_FAILED to IdsM (see [26] and table
[SWS_DM_02137]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02137].
⌋
The DoIP routing activation check is described in ISO 13400-2 in the figure "DoIP
routing activation handler".
[SWS_DM_02137] Security event context data definition: SEV_DOIP_ROUTING_
ACTIVATION_CHECK_FAILED

DRAFT
